examples.zh: 大多数航空公司要求狗狗乘坐符合国际航协尺寸和通风规定的航空箱飞行。

examples.en: She bought a sturdy pet travel carrier with a leak-proof tray before the international move.
examples.zh: 国际搬家前，她买了一个带防漏底盘、结实的航空箱。

entries.shortAnswer: 「指甲剪」在养宠场景常说 pet nail trim，指宠物指甲剪或给宠物剪指甲。
entries.definition: 养宠场景里，pet nail trim 可指宠物指甲剪，也可指给宠物剪指甲的护理行为。常见搭配有 do a pet nail trim、pet nail trim clipper。

examples.en: My cat hates getting a pet nail trim, so I have to wrap her in a towel first.
examples.zh: 我家猫特别讨厌剪指甲，所以我得先用毛巾把它裹起来。

examples.en: Before you buy a pet nail trim, check whether the blade is sharp enough for thick dog claws.
examples.zh: 买宠物指甲剪之前，先确认刀片是否够锋利，能剪得动狗狗厚厚的爪子。

entries.shortAnswer: Pet nail trim 就是「指甲剪」，指宠物指甲剪或给宠物剪指甲，别和人用的 nail clipper 混用。
entries.definition: Pet nail trim 指宠物指甲修剪，既可作名词，也可表示护理行为。常见搭配有 give the dog a pet nail trim、pet nail trim clipper。

examples.en: My cat hates getting a pet nail trim, so I have to wrap her in a towel first.
examples.zh: 我家猫特别讨厌剪指甲，所以我得先用毛巾把它裹起来。

examples.en: Before you buy a pet nail trim, check whether the blade is sharp enough for thick dog claws.
examples.zh: 买宠物指甲剪之前，先确认刀片是否够锋利，能剪得动狗狗厚厚的爪子。

entries.shortAnswer: 「洗澡」在养宠语境下常说的英文是 pet bath session；给宠物洗澡通常用 give a pet bath session。
entries.definition: pet bath session 特指给宠物（猫狗等）洗澡的完整流程，从打湿、上宠物香波到冲洗吹干。日常也说 bath time，但 pet bath session 更强调一次完整洗护。

examples.en: My dog hates water, so a pet bath session usually turns into a wrestling match in the tub.
examples.zh: 我的狗怕水，所以给它洗澡通常变成在浴缸里的一场摔跤。

examples.en: After the pet bath session, I always give my cat a treat and let her nap in the sun.
examples.zh: 给猫洗完澡后，我总会给它一点零食，让它在太阳下打个盹。

entries.shortAnswer: pet bath session 的中文意思是「洗澡」，尤其指给宠物做一次完整洗护；专用于猫狗等宠物的洗澡场景。
entries.definition: pet bath session 指给宠物洗澡的一次完整流程，包括打湿、上宠物香波、冲洗和吹干。常见搭配：give the dog a pet bath session、a weekly pet bath session。

examples.en: My dog hates water, so a pet bath session usually turns into a wrestling match in the tub.
examples.zh: 我的狗怕水，所以给它洗澡通常变成在浴缸里的一场摔跤。

examples.en: After the pet bath session, I always give my cat a treat and let her nap in the sun.
examples.zh: 给猫洗完澡后，我总会给它一点零食，让它在太阳下打个盹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「狗公园」的英文是 dog park，指专门让狗不牵绳自由活动的封闭场地。别直译成 dog garden，那是「狗的花园」。
entries.definition: dog park 是可数名词，美式常用，指围起来、允许狗不牵绳社交奔跑的公共绿地。常见搭配：go to the dog park、dog park etiquette（礼仪）。英式有时说 dog walking field。

examples.en: We take our golden retriever to the dog park every Saturday morning so she can run off-leash.
examples.zh: 我们每周六早上带金毛去狗公园，让它不牵绳自由奔跑。

examples.en: Before entering the dog park, make sure your dog is vaccinated and not aggressive toward other dogs.
examples.zh: 进狗公园之前，要确认你的狗已接种疫苗，且对其他狗没有攻击性。

entries.shortAnswer: dog park 的中文意思是「狗公园」，即供狗不牵绳自由活动的封闭场地，强调不牵绳社交空间。
entries.definition: dog park 是可数名词，多用于美式英语，指专门划出、通常有围栏、允许狗不牵绳活动的公园区域。常见搭配：take the dog to the dog park。不要与 dog run（较小的围栏活动区）混淆。

examples.en: We take our golden retriever to the dog park every Saturday morning so she can run off-leash.
examples.zh: 我们每周六早上带金毛去狗公园，让它不牵绳自由奔跑。

examples.en: Before entering the dog park, make sure your dog is vaccinated and not aggressive toward other dogs.
examples.zh: 进狗公园之前，要确认你的狗已接种疫苗，且对其他狗没有攻击性。

entries.shortAnswer: 训猫的英文是 cat training，指用奖励教会猫咪用猫砂、不抓家具等行为。
entries.definition: cat training 常搭配 do、start、tips、pads。训练猫讲究短时多次、零食奖励，铲屎官常说 training my cat to use the litter box。

examples.en: With patience and treats, cat training can teach your kitten to use the litter box in days.
examples.zh: 只要有耐心和零食，训猫能在几天内教会小猫使用猫砂盆。

examples.en: Many cat training guides suggest short sessions because cats lose interest quickly.
examples.zh: 许多训猫指南建议每次训练时间要短，因为猫很快就会失去兴趣。

entries.shortAnswer: Cat training is 训猫 in Chinese: teaching a cat good habits like using a litter box.
entries.definition: Cat training means shaping behavior with treats or clickers. Common collocations: cat training tips, litter box training, cat training pads.

examples.en: With patience and treats, cat training can teach your kitten to use the litter box in days.
examples.zh: 只要有耐心和零食，训猫能在几天内教会小猫使用猫砂盆。

examples.en: Many cat training guides suggest short sessions because cats lose interest quickly.
examples.zh: 许多训猫指南建议每次训练时间要短，因为猫很快就会失去兴趣。

entries.shortAnswer: 「猫爬架」英文是 cat tree，宠物店和电商都这么说，别直译成 cat climbing frame。
entries.definition: cat tree 是可数名词，指供猫攀爬、磨爪、休息的多层家具，也叫 cat tower 或 cat condo。买用品说 buy a cat tree。

examples.en: We bought a tall cat tree so our two cats would stop scratching the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们买了一个高的猫爬架，这样两只猫就不会再抓沙发了。

examples.en: The kitten spends all afternoon napping on the top platform of the cat tree.
examples.zh: 这只小猫整个下午都趴在猫爬架顶层的平台上打盹。

entries.shortAnswer: A cat tree is a 猫爬架 in Chinese: a multi-level piece for cats to climb and scratch.
entries.definition: cat tree 指多层猫用攀爬家具，口语常与 cat tower、cat condo 换用。搭配：climb the cat tree、a tall cat tree。

examples.en: We bought a tall cat tree so our two cats would stop scratching the sofa.
examples.zh: 我们买了一个高的猫爬架，这样两只猫就不会再抓沙发了。

examples.en: The kitten spends all afternoon napping on the top platform of the cat tree.
examples.zh: 这只小猫整个下午都趴在猫爬架顶层的平台上打盹。

entries.shortAnswer: 「私教」的英文是 personal trainer，指一对一指导你训练的人。注意 personal trainer 侧重健身教练，学校的私人教师一般说 private tutor。
entries.definition: personal trainer 指在健身房提供一对一指导的专业教练，常搭配 hire a personal trainer、work with a personal trainer。若指学科补习的私教，英语更常用 private tutor，别混用。

examples.en: I hired a personal trainer to help me improve my squat form.
examples.zh: 我请了一位私教来帮我改进深蹲姿势。

examples.en: My personal trainer designed a weekly plan that mixes strength training with cardio.
examples.zh: 我的私教制定了一份把力量训练和有氧结合起来的每周计划。

entries.shortAnswer: personal trainer 的中文意思是「私教」，即健身房裡一对一指导你训练的教练。它强调健身训练，不等同于教文化课的 private tutor。
entries.definition: personal trainer 指受雇于个人、定制训练计划的健身教练。常见搭配 hire/work with a personal trainer、certified personal trainer。口语中可简称 PT，正式场合仍用全称。

examples.en: I hired a personal trainer to help me improve my squat form.
examples.zh: 我请了一位私教来帮我改进深蹲姿势。

examples.en: My personal trainer designed a weekly plan that mixes strength training with cardio.
examples.zh: 我的私教制定了一份把力量训练和有氧结合起来的每周计划。

entries.shortAnswer: 「代餐」的英文是 meal replacement，指替代正餐的粉末或奶昔，主打控热量。
entries.definition: 代餐对应 meal replacement，常见搭配有 meal replacement shake 与 meal replacement powder。它多用于减重语境，长期替代三餐易营养不足。

examples.en: She skipped lunch and had a meal replacement shake instead, hoping to cut calories.
examples.zh: 她没吃午饭，只喝了一杯代餐奶昔，想减少热量摄入。

examples.en: Nutritionists warn that using meal replacement products for all three meals can lead to nutrient deficiencies.
examples.zh: 营养学家警告，一日三餐都吃代餐产品可能导致营养缺乏。

entries.shortAnswer: meal replacement 的中文是「代餐」，指替代正餐的粉末或奶昔，主打低热量与减重。
entries.definition: meal replacement 指代餐，常见搭配有 meal replacement shake 和 meal replacement powder。它不等于可长期代替三餐，营养易失衡。

examples.en: She skipped lunch and had a meal replacement shake instead, hoping to cut calories.
examples.zh: 她没吃午饭，只喝了一杯代餐奶昔，想减少热量摄入。

examples.en: Nutritionists warn that using meal replacement products for all three meals can lead to nutrient deficiencies.
examples.zh: 营养学家警告，一日三餐都吃代餐产品可能导致营养缺乏。

entries.shortAnswer: 「健身打卡」英文常说 gym check-in，指每天坚持去健身房并记录晒图，是社交坚持文化
entries.definition: gym check-in 侧重坚持记录并晒出，可搭配 do a gym check-in；若只表示到店签到，用 check in at the gym 更准确。

examples.en: I’ve kept up my gym check-in for thirty days straight, and my friends are all reacting to my posts.
examples.zh: 我已经连续三十天健身打卡，朋友们都在给我的帖子点赞留言。

examples.en: Her gym check-in photos always include a sweaty selfie and a short note about her workout.
examples.zh: 她的健身打卡照片总是包括一张流汗自拍和一段简短的训练记录。

entries.shortAnswer: Gym check-in means “健身打卡”: the social habit of logging and posting your daily workout online.
entries.definition: Gym check-in 指“健身打卡”，常搭配 do a gym check-in、daily gym check-in，多用于社交媒体；若指实体签到，则用 check in at the gym。

examples.en: I’ve kept up my gym check-in for thirty days straight, and my friends are all reacting to my posts.
examples.zh: 我已经连续三十天健身打卡，朋友们都在给我的帖子点赞留言。

examples.en: Her gym check-in photos always include a sweaty selfie and a short note about her workout.
examples.zh: 她的健身打卡照片总是包括一张流汗自拍和一段简短的训练记录。

entries.shortAnswer: 「戒糖」的英文是 quitting sugar，指主动停止吃添加糖或含糖食品，强调戒断行为。
entries.definition: quitting sugar 常与 quit 或 be 连用，表示正在戒糖或已戒糖；口语中也可说 give up sugar，但 quitting sugar 更突出戒断过程。

examples.en: Since quitting sugar three months ago, she has lost weight and her skin has cleared up.
examples.zh: 自从三个月前戒糖以来，她瘦了，皮肤也变好了。

examples.en: Quitting sugar is harder than it sounds because added sugar hides in sauces and drinks.
examples.zh: 戒糖说起来容易做起来难，因为添加糖藏在酱料和饮料里。

entries.shortAnswer: Quitting sugar 的中文意思是「戒糖」，即停止摄入添加糖或高糖食物，强调彻底戒断。
entries.definition: quitting sugar 是口语和书面皆可的动名词短语，常搭配 try、be、go through with。注意 quit 后直接跟 sugar，不说 quit from sugar。

examples.en: Since quitting sugar three months ago, she has lost weight and her skin has cleared up.
examples.zh: 自从三个月前戒糖以来，她瘦了，皮肤也变好了。

examples.en: Quitting sugar is harder than it sounds because added sugar hides in sauces and drinks.
examples.zh: 戒糖说起来容易做起来难，因为添加糖藏在酱料和饮料里。

entries.shortAnswer: 「轻断食」的英文是 intermittent fasting，常缩写为 IF。注意「轻」指限时段或限热量，不是完全不吃。
entries.definition: 指 16:8、5:2 等限时或限热量进食法。常用搭配：do intermittent fasting、try 16:8。英文口语常说 IF，不说 light fasting。

examples.en: She practices intermittent fasting with an 8-hour eating window and skips breakfast.
examples.zh: 她采用轻断食，把进食窗口控制在八小时，并且不吃早餐。

examples.en: Many people try intermittent fasting to lose weight, but it is not a magic cure.
examples.zh: 很多人尝试轻断食来减肥，但它并不是灵丹妙药。

entries.shortAnswer: Intermittent fasting 的中文是「轻断食」，指 16:8 或 5:2 等限时进食法。不是完全禁食，而是限制进食窗口或热量。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：practice/do intermittent fasting、16:8 intermittent fasting。正式场合用全称，口语常缩写为 IF。注意与 starvation、full fasting 区分。

examples.en: She practices intermittent fasting with an 8-hour eating window and skips breakfast.
examples.zh: 她采用轻断食，把进食窗口控制在八小时，并且不吃早餐。

examples.en: Many people try intermittent fasting to lose weight, but it is not a magic cure.
examples.zh: 很多人尝试轻断食来减肥，但它并不是灵丹妙药。

entries.shortAnswer: 「增重」的英文是 bulking up，特指健身增肌，常与 go on a bulk 搭配。
entries.definition: bulking up 指健身者通过力量训练与高蛋白饮食增加肌肉量。名词形式 a bulk，如 clean bulk 指干净增肌。

examples.en: He's been bulking up for six months and has gained ten pounds of muscle.
examples.zh: 他增重了六个月，长了十磅肌肉。

examples.en: If you want to bulk up, you need to eat more protein and lift heavy weights.
examples.zh: 如果你想增重，就需要多吃蛋白质并做大重量训练。

entries.shortAnswer: Bulking up means 增重 in fitness, gaining muscle via training and a calorie surplus.
entries.definition: Bulking up is gaining weight, mostly muscle, through strength training and eating more. The noun is a bulk, as in a clean bulk.

examples.en: He's been bulking up for six months and has gained ten pounds of muscle.
examples.zh: 他增重了六个月，长了十磅肌肉。

examples.en: If you want to bulk up, you need to eat more protein and lift heavy weights.
examples.zh: 如果你想增重，就需要多吃蛋白质并做大重量训练。

entries.shortAnswer: 「跑步机」的英文是 treadmill，指健身房中让人原地跑动的有氧器械；注意其也可引申为「枯燥单调的工作或生活」。
entries.definition: 作「跑步机」时是可数名词，常用搭配：run on the treadmill、treadmill workout、set the treadmill to incline。口语也说 hop on the treadmill。

examples.en: He runs on the treadmill for thirty minutes every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 他每天早饭前在跑步机上跑三十分钟。

examples.en: The treadmill at the gym was broken, so she decided to run outside instead.
examples.zh: 健身房那台跑步机坏了，所以她决定改去户外跑。

entries.shortAnswer: Treadmill 的中文意思是「跑步机」，即健身房中让人原地跑动的有氧器械，也可引申指「枯燥单调的工作或生活」。
entries.definition: 核心义为「跑步机」，常见搭配有 on the treadmill、treadmill run、treadmill belt。口语常用 go on the treadmill。引申义指周而复始的枯燥状态。

examples.en: He runs on the treadmill for thirty minutes every morning before breakfast.
examples.zh: 他每天早饭前在跑步机上跑三十分钟。

examples.en: The treadmill at the gym was broken, so she decided to run outside instead.
examples.zh: 健身房那台跑步机坏了，所以她决定改去户外跑。

entries.shortAnswer: 体测的英文是 body composition test，指健身房用仪器测体脂率、肌肉量的身体成分测试，不等于体检。
entries.definition: 体测即身体成分测试，常用搭配 do a body composition test、get a body composition test。它测的是体脂率、肌肉量等健身数据，体检则是查疾病的健康筛查。

examples.en: I get a body composition test every three months to track my body fat percentage.
examples.zh: 我每三个月做一次体测，跟踪自己的体脂率。

examples.en: The gym offers a free body composition test for new members.
examples.zh: 这家健身房为新会员提供一次免费体测。

entries.shortAnswer: body composition test 的中文意思是体测，指测量体脂率、肌肉量等身体成分的测试，不同于体检。
entries.definition: body composition test 是健身语境下的体测，常用搭配 get a body composition test、body comp test。易错点：别和 medical checkup 体检混淆。

examples.en: I get a body composition test every three months to track my body fat percentage.
examples.zh: 我每三个月做一次体测，跟踪自己的体脂率。

examples.en: The gym offers a free body composition test for new members.
examples.zh: 这家健身房为新会员提供一次免费体测。

entries.shortAnswer: 「燃脂」的英文是 fat burning，作形容词或名词短语，如 fat-burning workout。别直译成 burn fat，那是动词短语。
entries.definition: fat burning 指身体消耗脂肪供能的过程，常见搭配有 fat burning zone、fat burning exercise。作定语时通常加连字符写成 fat-burning。口语中也可说 burn fat，但那是动词用法。

examples.en: To stay in the fat burning zone, keep your heart rate between 60 and 70 percent of your maximum.
examples.zh: 为了保持在燃脂心率区间，请将心率控制在最大心率的百分之六十到七十之间。

examples.en: Many people believe that morning cardio is the best fat burning workout, but consistency matters more.
examples.zh: 很多人认为晨间有氧是最好的燃脂训练，但坚持比训练时间更重要。

entries.shortAnswer: fat burning 的中文意思是「燃脂」，指身体消耗脂肪供能的过程，强调脂肪作为燃料被氧化，不同于单纯减重。
entries.definition: fat burning 作名词或形容词，常见搭配有 fat burning zone、fat-burning foods。健身语境中指中低强度长时间运动；口语中也可说 burn fat。注意与 fat loss 区别。

examples.en: To stay in the fat burning zone, keep your heart rate between 60 and 70 percent of your maximum.
examples.zh: 为了保持在燃脂心率区间，请将心率控制在最大心率的百分之六十到七十之间。

examples.en: Many people believe that morning cardio is the best fat burning workout, but consistency matters more.
examples.zh: 很多人认为晨间有氧是最好的燃脂训练，但坚持比训练时间更重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 「节食」的英文是 dieting，指为减重而控制饮食，注意与名词 diet（日常饮食）区分。
entries.definition: dieting 侧重长期限制热量摄入来减重，常搭配 go on a diet、crash dieting；与 healthy eating 不同，它隐含减肥目的。

examples.en: She has been dieting for three months and finally lost five kilos.
examples.zh: 她已经节食三个月，终于瘦了五公斤。

examples.en: Crash dieting may help you lose weight fast, but it is hard to keep the results.
examples.zh: 极端节食也许能让你快速瘦身，但效果很难保持。

entries.shortAnswer: Dieting means 「节食」in Chinese: eating less to lose weight, unlike a diet (日常饮食) or healthy eating.
entries.definition: Dieting is restricting food or calories to lose weight, as in crash dieting. It implies a weight-loss goal and can sound slightly negative.

examples.en: She has been dieting for three months and finally lost five kilos.
examples.zh: 她已经节食三个月，终于瘦了五公斤。

examples.en: Crash dieting may help you lose weight fast, but it is hard to keep the results.
examples.zh: 极端节食也许能让你快速瘦身，但效果很难保持。

entries.shortAnswer: 「平板支撑」的英文是 plank，指一种用前臂和脚尖撑地、身体保持一条直线的核心训练动作。注意别和「侧平板支撑」side plank 混淆，后者是侧向支撑。
entries.definition: plank 是核心训练的基础静力动作，常见搭配有 do a plank、hold a plank、front plank，复数 planks 指多组。日常说「撑平板」就用 hold a plank。

examples.en: She holds a plank for two minutes every morning to strengthen her core.
examples.zh: 她每天早上做两分钟平板支撑来强化核心。

examples.en: If regular planks feel too easy, try lifting one arm or leg while you hold the position.
examples.zh: 如果普通平板支撑对你来说太轻松，可以尝试在保持姿势时抬起一只手臂或一条腿。

entries.shortAnswer: Plank 在中文里是「平板支撑」，一种用前臂和脚尖撑地、身体绷直的核心静力训练动作。它和 side plank（侧平板支撑）不同，后者身体侧向支撑。
entries.definition: plank 作名词指平板支撑动作，也作动词表示做平板支撑。常见搭配有 hold a plank、do planks、plank challenge。口语中常说 I'm gonna plank for two minutes。

examples.en: She holds a plank for two minutes every morning to strengthen her core.
examples.zh: 她每天早上做两分钟平板支撑来强化核心。

examples.en: If regular planks feel too easy, try lifting one arm or leg while you hold the position.
examples.zh: 如果普通平板支撑对你来说太轻松，可以尝试在保持姿势时抬起一只手臂或一条腿。

entries.shortAnswer: 核心训练用英语说是 core training，指针对腰腹、下背和骨盆区域稳定肌群的训练体系。口语也常说 core workout，但更强调单次训练课。
entries.definition: 常见搭配有 do core training、core training exercises、core strength。注意它指训练方式，不是肌肉本身；也不宜一律译为核心力量训练，后者更接近 core strength training。

examples.en: I do core training three times a week to improve my posture and reduce lower back pain.
examples.zh: 我每周做三次核心训练，以改善体态并减轻下背疼痛。

examples.en: Our coach says core training is more important than endless sit-ups for building real strength.
examples.zh: 我们的教练说，想要真正提升力量，核心训练比没完没了地做仰卧起坐更重要。

entries.shortAnswer: Core training 的中文意思是核心训练，指锻炼腹部、下背和骨盆稳定肌群的训练。与 core workout 不同，core training 更强调系统性和长期性。
entries.definition: Core training 是健身领域常用中性表达，可搭配 do core training、core training routine、core training exercises。它不等于 abs training，核心训练还包括稳定、平衡和发力传导。

examples.en: I do core training three times a week to improve my posture and reduce lower back pain.
examples.zh: 我每周做三次核心训练，以改善体态并减轻下背疼痛。

examples.en: Our coach says core training is more important than endless sit-ups for building real strength.
examples.zh: 我们的教练说，想要真正提升力量，核心训练比没完没了地做仰卧起坐更重要。

entries.shortAnswer: 「心率」的英文是 heart rate，指每分钟心跳的次数。注意与 pulse（脉搏）区分：heart rate 是数值，pulse 是能摸到的跳动。
entries.definition: heart rate 常用于运动与医疗语境，如 resting heart rate（静息心率）、target heart rate（目标心率）、elevated heart rate（心率升高）。健身里说的燃脂心率即 fat-burning heart rate zone。

examples.en: My resting heart rate dropped from 78 to 62 after three months of regular running.
examples.zh: 坚持跑步三个月后，我的静息心率从 78 降到了 62。

examples.en: The smartwatch keeps tracking your heart rate during the whole workout.
examples.zh: 这款智能手表会在整个训练过程中持续监测你的心率。

entries.shortAnswer: 「heart rate」的中文意思是「心率」，即每分钟心跳的次数。它与 pulse（脉搏）不同：heart rate 是频率数值，pulse 是触摸到的搏动。
entries.definition: heart rate 是健身与医学常用词，指静息、运动或异常状态下的心跳频率。常见搭配有 resting heart rate、max heart rate、heart rate monitor（心率监测器）。

examples.en: My resting heart rate dropped from 78 to 62 after three months of regular running.
examples.zh: 坚持跑步三个月后，我的静息心率从 78 降到了 62。

examples.en: The smartwatch keeps tracking your heart rate during the whole workout.
examples.zh: 这款智能手表会在整个训练过程中持续监测你的心率。

entries.shortAnswer: 「退款保证」的英文是 money-back guarantee，常见于欧美电商退换货政策。注意不要写成 refund guarantee，后者不是固定搭配。
entries.definition: money-back guarantee 指商家承诺不满意可全额退款，常与 offer、come with、under 搭配，如 offer a 30-day money-back guarantee。与 return policy 不同，它强调退款承诺本身。

examples.en: This vacuum cleaner comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can try it risk-free.
examples.zh: 这款吸尘器提供 30 天退款保证，你可以零风险试用。

examples.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee on all unopened items within 60 days of purchase.
examples.zh: 该店对所有未开封商品提供购买后 60 天内的退款保证。

entries.shortAnswer: Money-back guarantee 的中文意思是「退款保证」，指商家承诺不满意可全额退款。与普通 return policy 不同，它更强调退款承诺而非退货流程。
entries.definition: money-back guarantee 指商家承诺不满意即全额退款，常用于零售、电商、订阅服务。搭配：offer/come with/have a money-back guarantee。口语中可省略 guarantee，说 money back。

examples.en: This vacuum cleaner comes with a 30-day money-back guarantee, so you can try it risk-free.
examples.zh: 这款吸尘器提供 30 天退款保证，你可以零风险试用。

examples.en: The store offers a money-back guarantee on all unopened items within 60 days of purchase.
examples.zh: 该店对所有未开封商品提供购买后 60 天内的退款保证。

entries.shortAnswer: 「白灼」的英文常用 plain poached，白灼虾可说 plain poached shrimp，强调清水烫熟、吃食材原味。
entries.definition: 白灼是粤菜经典技法：滚水或高汤快烫，不加浓酱，吃食材本味，白灼虾、白灼菜心都是代表菜；向英文用户解释时可说 blanched or poached in plain water，突出「清鲜」时用 plain poached。

examples.en: For a light and healthy dinner, I ordered plain poached shrimp with ginger and scallion oil.
examples.zh: 为了清淡健康的晚餐，我点了姜葱油白灼虾。

examples.en: The chef recommends plain poached choy sum to preserve its crisp texture and natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 厨师推荐白灼菜心，以保持其爽脆口感和自然清甜。

entries.shortAnswer: Plain poached (白灼) means briefly boiling food until just done and serving it with soy sauce.
entries.definition: Plain poached (白灼) is a Cantonese method of boiling food just until done, then serving it with soy sauce; it keeps dishes lean and light.

examples.en: For a light and healthy dinner, I ordered plain poached shrimp with ginger and scallion oil.
examples.zh: 为了清淡健康的晚餐，我点了姜葱油白灼虾。

examples.en: The chef recommends plain poached choy sum to preserve its crisp texture and natural sweetness.
examples.zh: 厨师推荐白灼菜心，以保持其爽脆口感和自然清甜。

entries.shortAnswer: 包邮门槛的英文是 free shipping threshold。注意 threshold 指最低金额，不是 shipping fee。
entries.definition: free shipping threshold 指订单满一定金额才免运费，常见搭配 reach/meet the free shipping threshold。中国常说“满X包邮”，英文更强调 threshold 这个金额门槛，不是“免邮费”本身。

examples.en: I added a few more items to my cart to reach the free shipping threshold.
examples.zh: 我又往购物车里加了几件商品，以达到包邮门槛。

examples.en: The store lowered its free shipping threshold from fifty dollars to thirty-five.
examples.zh: 这家店把包邮门槛从五十美元降到了三十五美元。

entries.shortAnswer: free shipping threshold 的中文意思是包邮门槛。它指达到一定订单金额才免运费，不是免运费本身。
entries.definition: free shipping threshold 指免运费所需的最低订单金额，常用于电商结账页和促销说明。口语也说 free shipping minimum；threshold 强调金额门槛，不是运费。

examples.en: I added a few more items to my cart to reach the free shipping threshold.
examples.zh: 我又往购物车里加了几件商品，以达到包邮门槛。

examples.en: The store lowered its free shipping threshold from fifty dollars to thirty-five.
examples.zh: 这家店把包邮门槛从五十美元降到了三十五美元。

entries.shortAnswer: 官方翻新的英文是 refurbished，指厂商回收检测后重新销售的认证产品，非全新但通常带保修。
entries.definition: 官方翻新即 refurbished，强调由厂商或授权方检测维修后重新出售，常与 certified 连用，区别于二手(used)和开箱(open box)。

examples.en: I bought a refurbished iPad from the official store and it works like new.
examples.zh: 我从官方商店买了一台官方翻新平板电脑，用起来跟新的一样。

examples.en: Certified refurbished products often come with a one-year warranty.
examples.zh: 官方认证翻新产品通常带一年保修。

entries.shortAnswer: Refurbished 中文意思是官方翻新，指退货或旧机经厂商检测维修后重新出售，通常有官方保修。
entries.definition: Refurbished 指官方或授权翻新，常见搭配 certified refurbished、manufacturer refurbished；比 used 更可靠，但非全新，购买时注意保修范围。

examples.en: I bought a refurbished iPad from the official store and it works like new.
examples.zh: 我从官方商店买了一台官方翻新平板电脑，用起来跟新的一样。

examples.en: Certified refurbished products often come with a one-year warranty.
examples.zh: 官方认证翻新产品通常带一年保修。

entries.shortAnswer: 「会员积分」的英文是 loyalty points。它指顾客在商店或平台消费后累积的奖励分，与 membership points 不同，loyalty points 更强调品牌忠诚度计划。
entries.definition: loyalty points 常用于海淘和电商语境，搭配 earn/redeem/redeem for 等动词。注意：它是可数名词复数，单数 a loyalty point 极少用；积分兑换说 redeem loyalty points for rewards。

examples.en: You can redeem your loyalty points for a free gift or a discount on your next order.
examples.zh: 你可以用会员积分兑换免费礼品或下次订单的折扣。

examples.en: I earned a lot of loyalty points during the Black Friday sale, so I'm saving them for a big purchase.
examples.zh: 我在黑色星期五促销期间赚了很多会员积分，所以打算攒着买大件。

entries.shortAnswer: loyalty points 的中文意思是「会员积分」。它特指商家为鼓励重复消费而给的奖励分，不同于普通 discount 或 cashback，通常可兑换商品或折扣。
entries.definition: loyalty points 是美式电商常用词，口语也说 points。常见搭配：earn/redeem/accumulate loyalty points。注意：它属于奖励计划机制，不是直接现金，兑换时可能有门槛或过期限制。

examples.en: You can redeem your loyalty points for a free gift or a discount on your next order.
examples.zh: 你可以用会员积分兑换免费礼品或下次订单的折扣。

examples.en: I earned a lot of loyalty points during the Black Friday sale, so I'm saving them for a big purchase.
examples.zh: 我在黑色星期五促销期间赚了很多会员积分，所以打算攒着买大件。

entries.shortAnswer: 开箱二手品的英文是 open box，指拆封过但功能完好的商品，不等于全新，也不同于翻新。
entries.definition: open box 指顾客拆封或退货后经检查、配件较全、成色近新的商品，售价低于全新品，常见搭配 open box deal、open box condition。

examples.en: I saved almost a hundred dollars by buying an open box laptop instead of a brand-new one.
examples.zh: 我买了一台开箱二手品笔记本电脑，而不是全新的，省了将近一百美元。

examples.en: The listing says it's an open box item, so all accessories are included but the original packaging is slightly damaged.
examples.zh: 商品描述说这是开箱二手品，所以配件齐全，但原包装有轻微破损。

entries.shortAnswer: open box 的中文意思是开箱二手品，指已拆封、可能被短暂使用但功能正常的商品。
entries.definition: open box 指被顾客拆封或退回、经商家检查后重新出售的商品，并非全新，也不同于厂家翻新的 refurbished。

examples.en: I saved almost a hundred dollars by buying an open box laptop instead of a brand-new one.
examples.zh: 我买了一台开箱二手品笔记本电脑，而不是全新的，省了将近一百美元。

examples.en: The listing says it's an open box item, so all accessories are included but the original packaging is slightly damaged.
examples.zh: 商品描述说这是开箱二手品，所以配件齐全，但原包装有轻微破损。

entries.shortAnswer: 退货期限的英文是 return window，特指商家允许退货的有效时间段。别和 return policy（退货政策）混用，window 强调的是那段可退的时间窗口。
entries.definition: return window 常与 within、miss、extend 搭配，如 within the 30-day return window。美式零售中窗口长短因店而异，超过 window 就只能换货或拿 store credit。

examples.en: The return window for this jacket is 30 days from the delivery date, so you still have time.
examples.zh: 这件夹克的退货期限是送达日起 30 天，所以你还有时间。

examples.en: I missed the return window by one day, so the store only offered me store credit instead of a refund.
examples.zh: 我晚了一天错过退货期限，所以店家只给我店铺余额，而不是退款。

entries.shortAnswer: Return window 的中文意思是退货期限，指商家规定可以退货的那段时间，不指退货政策全文。它强调时间窗口，所以常和 miss、within 连用。
entries.definition: Return window 是美式零售常用词，指可退货的有效时段，如 a 30-day return window。口语常说 I missed the return window。注意它不等于退款到账时间，也不是保修期。

examples.en: The return window for this jacket is 30 days from the delivery date, so you still have time.
examples.zh: 这件夹克的退货期限是送达日起 30 天，所以你还有时间。

examples.en: I missed the return window by one day, so the store only offered me store credit instead of a refund.
examples.zh: 我晚了一天错过退货期限，所以店家只给我店铺余额，而不是退款。

entries.shortAnswer: 礼品小票的英文是 gift receipt，即不显示价格的购物凭证，方便收礼人退换货。
entries.definition: gift receipt 指不列价格的收据，用于退换货时证明购买来源。美国零售商普遍提供，退换常受退货窗口限制，可能只能换货或获得店铺余额。

examples.en: When you buy a gift for someone, always ask for a gift receipt so they can exchange it if needed.
examples.zh: 给别人买礼物时，一定要索要礼品小票，这样他们需要时就能退换。

examples.en: The store accepts returns with a gift receipt within 30 days, but you'll get store credit instead of a cash refund.
examples.zh: 该店接受凭礼品小票在三十天内退货，但你会获得店铺余额而非现金退款。

entries.shortAnswer: gift receipt 的中文是礼品小票，一种不显示价格的购物凭证，随礼物附赠方便退换。
entries.definition: gift receipt 是零售术语，指专为送礼设计的收据，省略价格但保留交易信息。常见搭配 include a gift receipt。退换时常受退货窗口限制，可能只能换货或获得店铺余额。

examples.en: When you buy a gift for someone, always ask for a gift receipt so they can exchange it if needed.
examples.zh: 给别人买礼物时，一定要索要礼品小票，这样他们需要时就能退换。

examples.en: The store accepts returns with a gift receipt within 30 days, but you'll get store credit instead of a cash refund.
examples.zh: 该店接受凭礼品小票在三十天内退货，但你会获得店铺余额而非现金退款。

entries.shortAnswer: 「清仓甩卖」的英文是 clearance，指商家清空库存的降价促销。注意 clearance 是商家主动清货，不是我们常说的“打折” discount。
entries.definition: clearance 常见搭配：clearance sale（清仓特卖）、on clearance（处于清仓价）、final clearance（最终清仓）。它强调清空库存，价格常为最低，且多不退不换。

examples.en: I bought these running shoes on clearance for half price.
examples.zh: 我趁清仓甩卖半价买了这双跑鞋。

examples.en: The store is having a clearance sale to make room for new arrivals.
examples.zh: 这家店正在清仓甩卖，为新货腾地方。

entries.shortAnswer: Clearance 的中文意思是「清仓甩卖」，指商家为清空库存而大幅降价。它与 discount 不同：discount 泛指打折，clearance 特指清货。
entries.definition: clearance 指零售商用低价清空剩余库存，常见搭配：clearance sale、on clearance、clearance rack。常为最终降价，商品可能断码、不可退换。

examples.en: I bought these running shoes on clearance for half price.
examples.zh: 我趁清仓甩卖半价买了这双跑鞋。

examples.en: The store is having a clearance sale to make room for new arrivals.
examples.zh: 这家店正在清仓甩卖，为新货腾地方。

entries.shortAnswer: 「订阅盲盒」英文是 subscription box，按月或按季定期寄送主题商品。
entries.definition: subscription box 指按月配送美妆、零食或宠物用品等主题盒，与一次性盲盒不同，多含自动续费。

examples.en: I signed up for a coffee subscription box that delivers a new roast every month.
examples.zh: 我订阅了一个每月寄送新烘焙咖啡豆的订阅盲盒。

examples.en: Before canceling your subscription box, check whether the next billing cycle has already started.
examples.zh: 取消订阅盲盒前，先确认下一个扣费周期是否已经开始。

entries.shortAnswer: A subscription box is 「订阅盲盒」, a recurring delivery of themed products.
entries.definition: Subscription box means a recurring curated package; common collocations: monthly subscription box, cancel a subscription box.

examples.en: I signed up for a coffee subscription box that delivers a new roast every month.
examples.zh: 我订阅了一个每月寄送新烘焙咖啡豆的订阅盲盒。

examples.en: Before canceling your subscription box, check whether the next billing cycle has already started.
examples.zh: 取消订阅盲盒前，先确认下一个扣费周期是否已经开始。

entries.shortAnswer: 店铺抵用余额的英文是 store credit，指退货后不退款到银行卡，而是把金额留在店铺里下次消费抵扣。注意它只能在该店铺用，不能提现。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：issue store credit（发放店铺抵用余额）、use/apply store credit（使用抵用余额）、store credit only（只退店铺余额）。它和 refund（原路退款）不同，通常不可提现，且可能过期。

examples.en: Since I lost the receipt, the store gave me store credit instead of a cash refund.
examples.zh: 因为我把收据弄丢了，店家没退现金，而是给了我店铺抵用余额。

examples.en: You can use your store credit online or in any physical store location.
examples.zh: 你可以在网上或任何实体店使用你的店铺抵用余额。

entries.shortAnswer: store credit 中文意思是店铺抵用余额，即退货时商家不退现金，而是把等额金额存到你的账户供下次购物抵扣。与 refund 不同，它通常不能提现。
entries.definition: store credit 常见于美国零售退货，搭配有 issue store credit、use store credit、store credit only。口语中也可说 merchandise credit。注意它只能在该商家使用，可能设有效期。

examples.en: Since I lost the receipt, the store gave me store credit instead of a cash refund.
examples.zh: 因为我把收据弄丢了，店家没退现金，而是给了我店铺抵用余额。

examples.en: You can use your store credit online or in any physical store location.
examples.zh: 你可以在网上或任何实体店使用你的店铺抵用余额。

entries.shortAnswer: 「礼品包装」的英文是 gift wrap，指用彩纸、缎带把商品包成礼物的材料或做法。
entries.definition: gift wrap 作名词指礼品包装纸或包装服务，如 free gift wrap；作动词指包装礼物，常写作 gift-wrap。

examples.en: The store offers free gift wrap during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 这家店在节日期间提供免费礼品包装。

examples.en: Could you gift-wrap this necklace? It's for my mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 你能把这条项链做礼品包装吗？这是送给我妈妈生日的。

entries.shortAnswer: gift wrap 的中文意思是「礼品包装」，指把商品用彩纸、缎带包成礼物的材料或服务。
entries.definition: gift wrap 指礼品包装纸或商家的包装服务，也可作动词表示包装礼物，常写作 gift-wrap。

examples.en: The store offers free gift wrap during the holiday season.
examples.zh: 这家店在节日期间提供免费礼品包装。

examples.en: Could you gift-wrap this necklace? It's for my mother's birthday.
examples.zh: 你能把这条项链做礼品包装吗？这是送给我妈妈生日的。

entries.shortAnswer: 「分期留货」的英文是 layaway，指先付定金让商家留货、之后分期付清再取货。注意它不是分期付款（installment），而是付清前商品由商家保管。
entries.definition: layaway 常见搭配：put sth on layaway（把某物办分期留货）、layaway plan（分期留货方案）。与 installment plan 不同：layaway 付清前拿不到货，且通常不计利息，多见于节日促销。

examples.en: I put the winter coat on layaway so I could pay for it a little at a time before Christmas.
examples.zh: 我把那件冬季外套办了分期留货，这样就能在圣诞节前一点一点付清。

examples.en: The store offers a layaway plan, but you can't take the item home until it's fully paid off.
examples.zh: 这家店提供分期留货方案，但你要付清全款才能把商品拿回家。

entries.shortAnswer: Layaway 的中文意思是「分期留货」，即先付定金、分期付清后商家才交货。与 installment plan 的关键区别是付清前商品由商家保留，顾客拿不到货。
entries.definition: layaway 指商家为顾客保留商品、顾客分次付款的购买方式，常见搭配 put sth on layaway、layaway plan。多用于美国零售（如节日促销），口语正式均可；注意不同于先拿货后付款的 installment。

examples.en: I put the winter coat on layaway so I could pay for it a little at a time before Christmas.
examples.zh: 我把那件冬季外套办了分期留货，这样就能在圣诞节前一点一点付清。

examples.en: The store offers a layaway plan, but you can't take the item home until it's fully paid off.
examples.zh: 这家店提供分期留货方案，但你要付清全款才能把商品拿回家。

entries.shortAnswer: “比价保障”英文是 price match guarantee，指商家承诺他处更便宜就补差价。
entries.definition: price match guarantee 常见于美国零售：购买后限期内发现更低价可退差价。搭配 ask for a price match。

examples.en: I bought this laptop yesterday, and now it's on sale at another store. Can I use the price match guarantee?
examples.zh: 我昨天买了这台笔记本电脑，现在另一家店在打折。我能用比价保障吗？

examples.en: Thanks to the price match guarantee, I got a refund for the difference when I found the same shoes cheaper online.
examples.zh: 多亏了比价保障，我在网上找到同款鞋子更便宜后拿到了差价退款。

entries.shortAnswer: Price match guarantee is “比价保障”: a store refunds the difference if you find a lower price.
entries.definition: A price match guarantee is a retailer promise to match a competitor’s lower price, with conditions like same item and time limit.

examples.en: I bought this laptop yesterday, and now it's on sale at another store. Can I use the price match guarantee?
examples.zh: 我昨天买了这台笔记本电脑，现在另一家店在打折。我能用比价保障吗？

examples.en: Thanks to the price match guarantee, I got a refund for the difference when I found the same shoes cheaper online.
examples.zh: 多亏了比价保障，我在网上找到同款鞋子更便宜后拿到了差价退款。

entries.shortAnswer: 「换货政策」的英文是 exchange policy，指商家允许顾客把商品换成同款其他尺码或颜色的规定，通常不等于退货退款。
entries.definition: 常见搭配：check the exchange policy（查换货政策）、within the exchange policy（在换货政策范围内）。注意它只管换同款商品，退货退款是 return policy，退成店铺余额叫 store credit。

examples.en: Before you buy, check the exchange policy in case the size doesn't fit.
examples.zh: 买之前先看一下换货政策，以防尺码不合适。

examples.en: Their exchange policy lets you swap an item within 30 days as long as you keep the receipt.
examples.zh: 他们的换货政策允许你在三十天内换货，只要保留收据就行。

entries.shortAnswer: exchange policy 的中文意思是「换货政策」，指商家允许顾客把商品换成其他尺码、颜色或款式的规定，和退货政策 return policy 不同。
entries.definition: 美国零售常见说法：under our exchange policy（按我们的换货政策）、a strict exchange policy，口语也说 exchange-only policy，即只换不退。换货一般要求保留收据、商品未穿未洗且吊牌完好。

examples.en: Before you buy, check the exchange policy in case the size doesn't fit.
examples.zh: 买之前先看一下换货政策，以防尺码不合适。

examples.en: Their exchange policy lets you swap an item within 30 days as long as you keep the receipt.
examples.zh: 他们的换货政策允许你在三十天内换货，只要保留收据就行。

entries.shortAnswer: 「降价提醒」的英文是 price drop alert，电商平台在你关注商品降价时发的通知。
entries.definition: 可数名词，常说 set up / get a price drop alert。海淘常见于亚马逊等平台，与到货提醒 back-in-stock alert 并列。

examples.en: I set up a price drop alert for the headphones I wanted, and got an email when they went on sale.
examples.zh: 我给自己想买的耳机设置了降价提醒，它打折时我就收到了邮件。

examples.en: Before you buy anything on Amazon, turn on a price drop alert so you don't miss a better deal.
examples.zh: 在亚马逊买东西前，先打开降价提醒，这样就不会错过更划算的价格。

entries.shortAnswer: price drop alert 的中文意思是「降价提醒」，指关注的商品降价时收到的通知。
entries.definition: 常用搭配 set up a price drop alert、get a price drop alert。属电商中性术语，口语也说 price alert。

examples.en: I set up a price drop alert for the headphones I wanted, and got an email when they went on sale.
examples.zh: 我给自己想买的耳机设置了降价提醒，它打折时我就收到了邮件。

examples.en: Before you buy anything on Amazon, turn on a price drop alert so you don't miss a better deal.
examples.zh: 在亚马逊买东西前，先打开降价提醒，这样就不会错过更划算的价格。

entries.shortAnswer: 「优惠码」的英文是 promo code，海淘结账时输入可享折扣，线上比 coupon 更常用。
entries.definition: promo code 是促销代码的缩写，结账时输入可享折扣或免邮。常见搭配：enter a promo code、apply a promo code。

examples.en: Don't forget to enter the promo code at checkout to get 20% off your order.
examples.zh: 结账时别忘了输入优惠码，可以享受订单八折优惠。

examples.en: I found a promo code online that gives free shipping on orders over $50.
examples.zh: 我在网上找到了一个优惠码，订单满五十美元可免运费。

entries.shortAnswer: “promo code”的中文意思是「优惠码」，即结账时输入的线上折扣码，比 coupon 更常用于网购。
entries.definition: promo code 指线上购物时输入的字母数字折扣代码，常见搭配：enter、apply、redeem a promo code，正式说法为 promotional code。

examples.en: Don't forget to enter the promo code at checkout to get 20% off your order.
examples.zh: 结账时别忘了输入优惠码，可以享受订单八折优惠。

examples.en: I found a promo code online that gives free shipping on orders over $50.
examples.zh: 我在网上找到了一个优惠码，订单满五十美元可免运费。

entries.shortAnswer: 「礼品卡」的英文是 gift card，指预付一定金额、可在指定商店或网站消费的卡片，常可反复使用至余额用完。
entries.definition: gift card 常用于电商和实体店语境，搭配 buy/redeem/reload a gift card。易错点：它一般不能提现，丢失常无法补办；与退货产生的 store credit 不同。

examples.en: I bought a gift card for my sister so she could pick out her own birthday present.
examples.zh: 我给妹妹买了一张礼品卡，这样她就能自己挑生日礼物了。

examples.en: You can redeem this gift card online or at any of our stores.
examples.zh: 这张礼品卡可以在网上或我们任意一家门店兑换使用。

entries.shortAnswer: gift card 的中文意思是「礼品卡」，是一种预付金额、可在特定商店或网站消费的卡片，多为塑料卡并可分期用完余额。
entries.definition: gift card 指零售商或平台发行的预付消费卡，常见搭配有 buy/redeem/reload a gift card、digital gift card。注意它通常不可提现，也不能用于其他商家。

examples.en: I bought a gift card for my sister so she could pick out her own birthday present.
examples.zh: 我给妹妹买了一张礼品卡，这样她就能自己挑生日礼物了。

examples.en: You can redeem this gift card online or at any of our stores.
examples.zh: 这张礼品卡可以在网上或我们任意一家门店兑换使用。

entries.shortAnswer: 「限时特惠」英文是 flash deal，指电商短时折扣；别与亚马逊商标 lightning deal 混用。
entries.definition: flash deal 强调限时、限量，通常持续几小时到一天，常见搭配 grab a flash deal、flash deal on 某商品。错过就恢复原价。

examples.en: I grabbed a flash deal on a pair of running shoes last night, but it expired in two hours.
examples.zh: 我昨晚抢到一双跑鞋的限时特惠，但两小时后就过期了。

examples.en: During Black Friday, many stores offer flash deals that last only a few hours.
examples.zh: 黑色星期五期间，许多商店会推出仅持续几小时的限时特惠。

entries.shortAnswer: 「限时特惠」英文是 flash deal，指电商限时几小时或一天的快速折扣，与 lightning deal 近义。
entries.definition: flash deal 指短暂、限量的促销，强调先到先得和倒计时。常见搭配 grab a flash deal, flash deal on electronics。

examples.en: I grabbed a flash deal on a pair of running shoes last night, but it expired in two hours.
examples.zh: 我昨晚抢到一双跑鞋的限时特惠，但两小时后就过期了。

examples.en: During Black Friday, many stores offer flash deals that last only a few hours.
examples.zh: 黑色星期五期间，许多商店会推出仅持续几小时的限时特惠。
